topic: Day 127 — reel — Patience with others and patience with yourself are different muscles
text:
You trained
patience for
[everyone] except
yourself.
caption:
Being generous with someone else's pace doesn't transfer automatically to your own. They're two separate muscles and most people only build one.

Follow for one of these a day.
